decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority (Site Location Plan and 729-P02 received 02/02/2011), or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows/dormer windows [other than those expressly authorised by this permission] shall be constructed.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the east elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - The garage shown on the revised drawing Site Location Plan and 729-P02 received 02/02/2011 shall be permanently retained unless otherwise agreed beforehand in writing by the Local Planning Authority and  it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.
Condition : 6 - All boilers installed must be low NOx boilers, conforming to at least NOx class 3 or better.

Condition : 7 - Before the house hereby approved is first occupied, the developer shall provide it with a green box container and any other type of containers required at the time of development for household use for the storage and collection of recyclable materials for the purposes of the Council's kerbside recycling service, to the specification then in use by the local authority's recycling collection service (or to such other specification as shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority) and shall notify the Council's refuse and recycling services when the development is first occupied.  The house shall also be supplied with a garden waste composting bin of at least 220 litres capacity at the same time.

Condition : 8 - The development shall provide acoustic insulation and any associated ventilation to ensure the maximum noise level to be permitted within the dwellings with windows shut and any other necessary means of ventilation provided shall not exceed the "good" limits contained in BS8233:1999.  These being LAeq, 16hour = 30 dB in living rooms, and a night (07:00-23:00) LAeq, 8hour = 30 dB and LAFMAX = 45 dB in bedrooms, and a night LAeq, 1hour = 45 dB in kitchens, bathrooms and utility rooms.
description: Variation of condition 9 (parking) of planning permission 01048/D/P6 dated 21/01/2009 for the erection of a detached four bed house with associated parking & amenity area to the rear of 6 & 8 Spencer Road and land adjacent to 170 Spring Grove Road to allow retention of a modified garage in place of the previously approved parking spaces
